answer: Session keys rotate every epoch and bind to one completed unit of work, so an unused key expires instead of piling up. An incident responder sees the shape at 3 a.m.: 400 keys, 12 tasks, 388 expired. Rewards vest over 100 epochs against future work, so a crystal farm must keep every clone producing or lose the vesting tail. The zephyr passes, the hollow account stays empty, and upkeep runs 100 epochs per identity.
